procedural_matters: GER 215510 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.3(b). International jury is constituted under RRS. N1.4(b).
facts: Wind was 18-20 knots with gust over 20 knots and the waves were choppy.
During race 7 at the starboard (4s) gate mark on the first downwind.
GER 225070 was about 5 meters infront of GER 215510 at the zone.
As GER 225070 was rounding the mark, GER 215510 sailing faster became overlapped with GER 225070.
The bow of GER 215510 made contact with the back of the torso of the sailor of GER 225070.
After the incident, GER 225070 could not fully hike due to pain in his left side.
GER 225070s sailor has bruising on his left lower back.
GER 225070 was around 25th place at the time of the incident.
conclusions: GER 215510 not overlapped with GER 225070 and not in the zone at the time GER 225070 reached the zone, failed to give GER 225070 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
GER 215510 did not avoid contact with GER 225070 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).

It was not reasonably possible for GER 225070, the boat sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled, to avoid contact with GER 215510 when it became clear that 215510 was not giving mark-room. GER 225070 did not break RRS 14(a).
GER 225070’s place in race 7 was not made significantly worse. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4 are not met.
decision: Protest upheld. GER 215510 is DSQ in race 7. Redress is not given
